name: Free Computer Training
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemen, serving soldiers, their widows, and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.
descriptionMd: The scheme "Free Computer Training" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemen, serving soldiers, their widows, and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.
benefitsMd: Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided with a one-year free training course in Computer, Accounting, Web Designing, or Digital Marketing.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman, serving soldier, widow of a serviceman, or their dependent, and must have passed the 12th standard.
applicationMd: Under the scheme, training is provided in all districts in the following subjects: 1. Diploma in Computer Applications and Programming (Duration – 1 year) 1. Diploma in Professional Accounting (Duration – 1 year) 1. Web Designing and Development (Duration – 1 year) 1. Digital Marketing (Duration – 1 year) ***The Director, Sainik Welfare Office, invites applications for these courses from ex-servicemen and their dependents through publicity campaigns. The following documents are required for application:*** 1. General application form 1. Aadhaar Card 1. Ex-serviceman Identity Card 1. Discharge Book 1. Educational certificate (12th pass) ***After verification, the concerned District Sainik Welfare Office forwards the list of eligible applicants to the training institute. The institute then informs the selected candidates and commences the training program.***
